what: Run-to-run repeatability of held-out Folmsbee energies: the same model on the same conformers, re-run in fresh processes with identical inputs.
reproduce: python scripts/orb_repeatability.py --publish (GPU, a few minutes); --from-saved --publish recomputes everything from the energies stored here, without a GPU
units: energies in eV under 'energies'; every |dE| and gap in kcal/mol
accuracy_definition: sign(model gap) == sign(reference gap) over every scored pair, as acc_under_1kcal in heldout_folmsbee_summary.json

history_full_set.note: Committed ORB-omol decisions before and after the charge fix. Neutral compounds had identical inputs in both (checked conformer by conformer), so their pairs are a full-set repeat; library versions of the first run were not recorded.

orb_delta_verdict.note: Accuracy is recomputed from each run, so every spread is measured. The step 0.823 -> 0.833 survives if it exceeds twice the full-set run-to-run shift (both endpoints carry it) and the charged pairs' net gain exceeds the most their decisions could move by noise.

sample.stratified_by: charge (neutral / charged), proportional to conformer share
